claim_scope.question: Can one frozen depth-two exact-V5.5 external-sampling MCCFR+ teacher produce a reproducible and held-out-useful root policy on 64 learner-reached public roots within the local resource envelope?
claim_scope.no_quick5k_reason: F64 creates no deployable checkpoint and changes no official policy.

falsifiable_hypothesis.mechanism: On learner-reached H11 public roots, exact blocker-aware posterior ranges plus depth-two exact-V5.5 MCCFR+ with frozen H11 continuation can find a stable root action distribution that improves paired held-out root value over H11 and reduces a consistently fitted sampled-BR gap.
falsifiable_hypothesis.primary_effect: E1 one-sided simultaneous 95% FWER lower bound for paired root-value uplift is at least +0.20 bb per reached root.
falsifiable_hypothesis.secondary_direction: E1 one-sided simultaneous 95% FWER lower bound for sampled-BR-gap reduction is greater than zero.
falsifiable_hypothesis.falsifier: Any registered structural, replica, range, resource, E0-selection, or sealed-E1 confirmation gate fails.
falsifiable_hypothesis.interpretation_limit: The +0.20 bb/root engineering minimum is not +20 bb/100 and has no direct external-effect conversion.

canonical_h11_policy.combo_order: Each unordered two-card own hand is (min_card,max_card); enumerate lexicographically over card integers after removing the public board only.

batch_contract.last_chunk_padding: duplicate the final real row through row255 and discard all padding outputs
batch_contract.probability_math: legal-mask softmax; selected legal action log probability accumulated in CPU float64

canonical_h11_policy.root_generation_coherence: At every census decision, evaluate the exact canonical chunk containing the actor's actual hole and sample from that row. This is bit-identical to that row in the full canonical likelihood pass without evaluating unrelated chunks.
canonical_h11_policy.repeat_gate: Every repeated identical canonical call is bit-identical. Reordering and alternate batch shapes are forbidden.
forbidden: source-opponent-hole blocker in an actor policy batch
source hidden cards in public root selection
autocast, compile, training mode, or alternate network loader

root_census.players: frozen H11 stochastic versus frozen H11 stochastic
root_census.game: fresh independently implemented exact-cent 200bb HUNL public engine; V5.5 exact nonnull nine-slot actions only
root_census.selection: For every eligible decision compute SHA256(namespace|source_hand_index|public_serialization); after the complete census choose the eight lowest hashes in each cell.
eligibility: at most one selected candidate per source hand
at least two legal nonnull V5.5 slots
complete public history reconstructable without projection
future exact tree may leaf before any seventh action on one street
selection hash excludes hidden cards,outcome,reward,H11 probability and later solver output
root_census.no_replacement: Missing cell quota or invalid selected root is terminal F64 NONPASS; do not data-dependently replace it.

belief_contract.target: mu_r(h0,h1) proportional to uniform ordered disjoint-hole prior times the chronological product of H11 probability for every observed public action under the acting player's candidate own hole.
belief_contract.joint_domain: Canonical unordered h0 then unordered h1; both exclude current public board and are mutually disjoint.
belief_contract.history: For each prefix use the canonical own-hole order compatible with that prefix's public board and the exact observed V5.5 slot.
belief_contract.normalization: CPU float64 logsumexp; store the full joint law or a lossless streamed equivalent; never multiply marginal ranges.
forbidden: conditioning weights on either source hidden hand or source outcome
range smoothing after observing a failed gate
factorized marginals as the sampling law

game_and_tree.solver_domain: Exact V5.5 executable nonnull nine-slot abstraction on a fresh exact-cent public engine.
game_and_tree.depth_count: player decisions beginning at the root; chance does not consume depth
game_and_tree.nonterminal_leaf: both players continue with frozen stochastic H11 to terminal using keyed exogenous chance and policy uniforms
game_and_tree.observation_overflow: Stop at the preceding node and value it by H11 continuation; never truncate or encode a seventh same-street action.

solver.replica_streams: SHA-counter namespaces are disjoint for joint deals,chance,opponent actions,H11 leaf actions and tie checks.
solver.iteration_unit: Freeze sigma_t; run one traversal for traverser0 and one independent traversal for traverser1; collect both delta tables; apply both simultaneously.

external_sampling.chance: sample exactly from uniform without-replacement target
external_sampling.leaf_return: one bounded zero-sum H11-continuation terminal outcome in big blinds
external_sampling.importance_weight: none because every external node is sampled from its target probability

regret_update.cfr_plus: R_(t+1)(I,a)=max(0,R_t(I,a)+delta_t(I,a)) after the complete two-traverser iteration
regret_update.regret_matching: normalize positive legal regrets; if their sum is zero use uniform over exact legal nonnull slots
regret_update.illegal: regret and strategy mass exactly zero
regret_update.arithmetic: float64 and finite checks after every update

root_average_only.scope: Only the acting player's root policy is exported; post-root evaluation play is frozen H11.
root_average_only.marginal: m_i(h)=sum over compatible opponent holes of mu_r
root_average_only.update: On sampled own hole h, S_i(h,a)+=t*sigma_t(I_h,a)/m_i(h); D_i(h)+=t/m_i(h).
root_average_only.snapshot: bar_sigma=S/D for the selected source learner hole.
root_average_only.forbidden_claim: No full-tree average-strategy correctness or exploitability claim.

required_contract_tests: fixed-seed Kuhn or Leduc convergence sanity test
all legal-slot and exact-cent transition tests

evaluation_banks.materialization: After implementation audit PASS, write immutable exogenous keyed randomness only; never store baseline trajectories for off-policy reuse.
evaluation_banks.contents: joint-deal draw,chance permutation and policy-uniform variates sufficient to replay each frozen profile on-policy

E0.profiles: H11 plus all three fixed ensemble snapshots

E1.profiles: H11 plus only the SHA-frozen E0-selected candidate
E1.sealing: Seed-manifest bytes and SHA are fixed before E0. E1 execution occurs only in a fresh confirmation process after candidate_manifest exists and binds t*,policy hashes,E0 judgment and unopened-E1 manifest SHA.

evaluation_banks.disjointness: Training,E0-fit,E0-eval,E1-fit,E1-eval,roots,roles and replicas have distinct SHA-counter namespaces.
evaluation_banks.pairing: Within one bank/profile comparison, common random tapes pair baseline and candidate but each profile consumes uniforms through its own on-policy action CDF.

heldout_value.per_tape: d=u_actor(candidate root action,H11 thereafter)-u_actor(H11 root action,H11 thereafter), using paired exogenous random tapes.
heldout_value.root_statistic: mean paired d over the evaluation split
heldout_value.campaign_weight: equal 1/8 for each street-by-actor cell and equal 1/8 for each root in a cell

sampled_br.name: INFOSET_CONSISTENT_SAMPLED_BR_GAP_DIRECTIONAL_SURROGATE
sampled_br.fit: On the phase fit split, external-sample against the frozen opponent profile, enumerate every BR action, aggregate action values across all hidden realizations sharing the infoset key, backward-select one action per key; ties choose smallest slot.
sampled_br.evaluation: Freeze the complete pure BR map before the phase evaluation split, then score it once without refitting.
sampled_br.unseen_eval_infoset: fall back to H11 and count uncovered counterfactual reach
sampled_br.required_counterexample_test: A hidden-card toy game must show the fitted infoset BR equals the valid information-set action and is strictly below a clairvoyant per-deal maximum.
sampled_br.claim_limit: This fitted BR is a lower bound on true BR value; sBR-gap may underestimate true NashConv and cannot certify equilibrium.

selection_and_confidence.experimental_cluster: source root; tapes,actions and leaves are not independent roots

bootstrap.method: hierarchical paired bootstrap: independently resample eight roots with replacement inside each of eight fixed cells, then resample evaluation tapes within each selected root while preserving the complete paired outcome vector

E0.quantities: uplift and sBR-gap reduction for each of T=2048,8192,32768; six one-sided tests
E0.multiplicity: Bonferroni FWER0.05; alpha=1/120 for each lower bound
E0.selection: Select the smallest T whose uplift LCB>=0.20, sBR reduction LCB>0 and every structural,range,replica,ESS,integrity and resource gate passes.

E1.quantities: uplift and sBR-gap reduction for the single frozen E0 candidate
E1.multiplicity: Bonferroni FWER0.05; alpha=0.025 for each lower bound
E1.pass: uplift LCB>=0.20 and sBR reduction LCB>0 plus every E1 integrity,coverage and ESS gate
E1.failure: terminal NONPASS; never reopen E0,select another snapshot,top up or reuse E1

resource_admission.position: After implementation audit PASS and before any census hand,root,belief,solver row or teacher row.
resource_admission.authority: A zero-science microbenchmark may load the frozen H11 model and exercise synthetic exact kernels only.
must_measure: canonical-chunk census inference plus exact-cent action throughput
both-traverser depth-two node visits and batched H11 terminal continuations
E0 BR fit/eval and paired profile replay
E1 BR fit/eval and paired profile replay
resource_admission.projection: Use exact registered upper work counts, the minimum rate across eight post-warmup fixed blocks for each stage, and a 1.25 multiplicative safety factor. Sum stage upper bounds plus measured fixed load/finalization.
resource_admission.failure: LRFT_F64_RESOURCE_ADMISSION_NONPASS; produce no root census or scientific rows and rerank. Do not add a performance-probe correction.

implementation_and_audit.fresh_runtime_graph: fresh exact-cent engine -> strict hybrid H11 loader and exact V5.5 encoder -> canonical batch256 likelihood -> coherent root census -> joint beliefs -> external-sampling MCCFR+ -> E0 selection -> sealed E1 confirmation -> exclusive bundle
implementation_and_audit.exclusive_writes: All scientific outputs use create-new semantics. No overwrite, append-to-frozen-output, reconstruction from missing raw evidence, or mutable latest pointer.

abort_on: any frozen input or identity mismatch
replica,ESS,BR coverage,E0 or E1 gate failure
missing raw tape,chunk,manifest,source hash or audit evidence
abort_and_judgment.rollback: No F64 artifact is deployable. Preserve every output read-only; H11 remains official.
abort_and_judgment.route_effect: A valid F64 NONPASS reranks or redesigns the teacher family but does not alone exhaust it unless the frozen evidence is a structural impossibility proof.
abort_and_judgment.external_trigger: Only a later separately preregistered BC checkpoint passing teacher/legality gates becomes eligible for mandatory greedy-direct quick5k.
